newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Arbed declines comment on CSI stake buy.
newsitem.headline: Arbed declines comment on CSI stake buy.

text.p: Luxembourg steel maker Arbed on Tuesday had no comment on news that Spanish state holding company AIE would propose that the government approve the sale of 35 percent of Corporacion Siderurgica Integral (CSI) to Arbed.
"No comment," an Arbed spokesman told Reuters when asked for a reaction to the news and details of the company's offer.

The Spanish government received two competing offers for the share in steel firm CSI. The other was from French steel group Usinor Sacilor which said this month it was offering 3.35 billion French francs for the stake.
The AIE -- Agencia Industrial de Estado -- which made the announcement earlier on Tuesday, is due to hold a news conference at midday (1000 GMT).
In Brussels Arbed shares were up 70 francs at 4,590 at 0850 GMT.
